meta.name: Prompt Enhancer for edits (Qwen3-VL 4B)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen3-VL-4B is Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen, 2025-10); the file is the one Krea 2's templates use as their text encoder. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Prompt rewriting with the picture in view: ComfyUI's TextGenerate runs the Qwen3-VL 4B encoder (loaded as Krea 2 loads it, CLIPLoader type krea2, the one encoder on the server that TextGenerate can generate with; the 2511 encoder cannot) as a vision-language model and PreviewAny reports the text in the history. The engine's instructions go in as a real system turn (`system`), the user's instruction as the user turn (`prompt`); temperature 0.3, at most 120 tokens: about 1 s on the 5090. `thinking` is true on purpose: the node's thinking=false appends an empty <think> block after the assistant turn, which this non-thinking Instruct model answers with nothing or with a stray 'assistant' (7 empty + 5 echoes of 12 runs, 2026-10-09); with thinking=true the chat template ends at the plain assistant turn and 26 of 26 runs answered cleanly. Found the same day: a 10 KB system prompt (the one shipped for Qwen-Image-2.1's enhancer) overwhelms the 4B model; a short one works.
